==Coin==
Copper, Silver and Gold coins are the currency used.

1 Gold Coin {{Gold Coin}} = 100 Silver Coins {{Silver Coin}}<br>
1 Silver Coin {{Silver Coin}} = 100 Copper Coins {{Copper Coin}}

So 1 Gold Coin {{Gold Coin}} = 10,000 Copper Coins {{Copper Coin}}

==Price==
For additional information on {{happiness}} and how it impacts prices, visit [[reputation]].

==Quality==
Copper, Silver, and Gold also represent item quality with Copper {{Quality|Copper}}, Silver {{Quality|Silver}}, and Gold {{Quality|Gold}} stars.
